processNotes: Historical routing records work center 60 for product 797; it does not establish the complete route or prescribe these operations.

Frame members, the fork, and other manufactured subassemblies arrive ready for the operations shown; their internal manufacture is outside this draft. Exact joining and fitting details are not supplied.
BOM quantities are per representative bicycle; the pedal entry is 1 EA and is not interpreted as a specific number of individual pedals.
variantNotes: All supplied variants are yellow, in sizes 38, 40, 42, 44, and 48. The recipe uses the Yellow, 38 frame FR-R72Y-38, product 822.

For size 40 use frame FR-R72Y-40, product 833; for 42 use FR-R72Y-42, product 834; for 44 use FR-R72Y-44, product 835; and for 48 use FR-R72Y-48, product 836. Each is 1 EA in its respective variant BOM.
The supplied variant BOMs list the same other direct components and quantities, including the same front and rear wheels. No alternate paint or wheel substitution is specified.

100291.title: Representative bicycle assembly arrangement
guidance: Secure 1 EA of ML Road Frame-W - Yellow, 38 (Product Number FR-R72Y-38) in an assumed bicycle assembly stand. Fit the staged fork and 1 EA of ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451); the source does not specify headset internals or fitting order.
Fit 1 EA each of ML Road Handlebars (Product Number HB-R720) and ML Road Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-R430). See the representative arrangement in illustration 100291.
Fit 1 EA of ML Road Front Wheel (Product Number FW-R762) at the front and 1 EA of ML Road Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-R762) at the rear; check that both rotate without obvious rubbing.
